verdict.rationale: Shortcut has its own built-in Automations feature. It auto-starts and auto-completes Epics, auto-creates future Iterations and rolls unfinished Stories into the next Iteration, all without manual action. The evidence shows only this fixed set of workflow rules, not user-configurable or agent-driven background automations. The REST API and MCP server are developer building blocks or interactive agent connections, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: user-defined triggers/actions or custom automation builder, scheduled or agent-run autonomous background tasks, in-depth docs on configuring automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automations Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
